t: The Unix Pipe of Life: From Mitochondria to Mr. Meseeks
s: This article explores a core pattern of 'input | process | output' found from biological cells (mitochondria) to Unix pipes and modern AI, positing this as a fundamental principle of innovation and antifragility. The 'AI Winter' is framed as a fortuitous accident that steered AI development towards safer, modular systems.
sub: Unix philosophy and the pipe operator as a computational API mirroring biological processes.
The dialectic between left-brain (abstraction, Master) and right-brain (holism, Emissary) in discovery and communication.
The 'AI Winter' as a Black Swan event leading to antifragile, modular AI development.
Jupyter Notebooks as a modern manifestation of the Unix philosophy for AI experimentation.
The application of 'input | process | output' across scales from cellular biology to AI safety.
